context.title: Housing Rights Committee of San Francisco: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

of.name: Housing Rights Committee of San Francisco

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: The Housing Rights Committee of San Francisco signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Housing Rights Committee signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I and the rebuttal to the argument against San Francisco Proposition I and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
